signal-coral.$description: Signal Coral — Primary action buttons, active links, icon accents, decorative badges — the only chromatic element allowed to fill space

ember-wash.$description: Ember Wash — Secondary warm accent for icon borders, decorative fills, and illustration strokes when coral needs a lighter companion

persimmon.$description: Persimmon — Deepest warm accent for icon borders, decorative fills, and hero illustration strokes

coral-mist.$description: Coral Mist — Soft pink-tinted wash for accent backgrounds, hover surfaces, and decorative bands

carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Primary text, filled neutral buttons, dark surface backgrounds

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark fills, outlined button borders

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle section backgrounds, tertiary surface layer

graphite.$description: Graphite — Badge fills, dark nav backgrounds, subtle card borders

slate.$description: Slate — Muted helper text, icon strokes, secondary borders, list dividers

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary text on light surfaces

gilroy.$description: All UI and display text. Used at 56px weight 700 for hero headlines with extremely tight leading (~0.80), creating chunky display blocks. Weight 600 for section headings at 48px, weight 500–600 for body 16–18px, weight 500 for nav and labels at 14px
